name: Creative Newtech Ltd
title: Creative Newtech Ltd - 544631 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Creative Newtech is a market-entry distributor with a rising brand mix; Q4 margins flattered by Make-in-India mix, while receivables jumped to ~20% of turnover and Middle East freight shock threatens brand sales.

triggers.label: Receivables 13.4% → ~20% of turnover
triggers.quote: that was 13.41% of turnover in the last year. And now currently, that is coming around 20%
triggers.highlight: 13.41% of turnover in the last year

triggers.label: Middle East brand sales could halve
triggers.quote: it's a chance that we could do only 50% of our business what we are doing there currently

triggers.label: Memory/storage/CPU costs up 30-40%
triggers.quote: the cost has gone up by 30%, 40%, especially memory and storage and CPUs

triggers.label: Brand business target 50-60% growth
triggers.quote: the brand business should at least grow between 50% to 60% every year

triggers.label: Q4 margin from Make-in-India mix
triggers.quote: because the suppliers or the vendors whom we are dealing with, their size is much smaller and that's why you get a higher percentage margin
triggers.highlight: you get a higher percentage margin

guidance.quote: we want to grow by at least in a year by 25%, 30% for sure
the brand business should at least grow between 50% to 60% every year
we are also looking to grow the business at least by 40%, 50%
in the brand business, we are expected to have the EBITDA of 13%
Our guidance was INR359 crores, INR360 crores. We did INR370 crores.

red_flags.label: Receivables ~20% of turnover vs 13.4% prior year
red_flags.quote: the receivables has gone up from INR237.7 crores to INR565. So if you understand from the turnover point of view, so that was 13.41% of turnover in the last year

red_flags.label: Middle East war disrupting brand exports
red_flags.quote: it's a chance that we could do only 50% of our business what we are doing there currently

red_flags.label: Inventory build to hedge price rises
red_flags.quote: passing the inventory also helps that the future escalation on the price we are able to manage

evasions.quote: we will not disclose numbers in Honeywell in the 4 categories of accessories, air purifier, home audio and Honeywell networking cable
